sender: Tom Ashby, Business Development, Greenlane Yield Analytics
subject: Farmland yield data: new field-level corn and soybean estimates - 2-week trial for Larchmont Ridge
body:
Hi Ellen,

With harvest underway across the Corn Belt, I wanted to introduce Greenlane Yield Analytics.

Our platform combines satellite imagery, county-level soil sampling and combine telemetry from ~3,800 farms to publish field-level yield estimates two to three weeks ahead of USDA updates.

Snapshot (as of Oct 12):
- Iowa corn: 204 bu/acre (+2.8% vs. USDA's September estimate of 198)
- Illinois soybeans: 63.1 bu/acre vs. 61.4 USDA
- Nebraska corn: 189 bu/acre, in line
- Late-planted fields in the northern tier showing ~4% lower test weights

How funds use it:
- Position ahead of the monthly USDA crop report
- Cross-check fertilizer and seed company volumes
- Hedge input-cost exposure for food and ethanol names

What's included in the trial:
- Full state and county tables
- Daily alerts by crop
- One onboarding call with our data science team

If your commodities or consumer desk could use it, I'd be happy to set up a 20-minute demo this week or next. Reply to this email or grab a slot here: greenlaneyield.com/demo

Best,
Tom Ashby
Business Development | Greenlane Yield Analytics
